injury_filter.rule: Exclude the entire player season after any documented injury/illness absence in a scheduled regular-season game.
injury_filter.evidence: Medical injury report Out with no participation-stat row; Questionable/Doubtful plus inactive roster with no stat row; medical reserve (IR/PUP/NFI) with no stat row. Rest, personal matters and suspension alone do not qualify.
injury_filter.interpretation: Retrospective healthy-season conditioning: future full-season injury outcomes determine eligibility. Confidence excludes future injury risk and can be more optimistic than an unconditional forecast. Unrecorded injury absences may remain.

touchdown_baselines.method: Historical TD rates by position, opportunity type and pre-play field zone (inside5, 6to20, outside20). RZ touches are carries plus completed receptions. QB passing attempts are separate.

methodology: Frozen workload_v1; cutoffs 2-14; horizons 1-4 calendar weeks; players observed at cutoff. Entire player seasons with any documented injury/illness absence are retrospectively excluded from calibration and evaluation. This intentionally conditions on future full-season health, so confidence is not an unconditional injury-inclusive probability. Other missing future stats count as zero. Actual total points divided by scheduled games for team at cutoff. Trades may alter actual opportunities. Historical corrected data, not archived real-time snapshots. Repeated players and overlapping windows are correlated. TD benchmarks use calibration seasons only, with the same injury-season filter. No ranks or tiers are backtested.
